user_feedback: Faces should mature across evolutions like Charmander's line in degree, and Megas should be far more dramatic.

prompts.mosshog: Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise this Mosshog family board in place as a new concept version. Keep the clean 2x2 sheet, all existing exact names/stage labels, the general illustration style, and the approved BASE MOSSHOG in the upper-left unchanged in identity and childlike face. The user rejected the other faces being the same baby face on bigger bodies. They want a true baby-to-adolescent-to-adult maturation comparable to the strength of Charmander-to-Charmeleon-to-Charizard's facial progression, without copying those designs. CHANGE THE HEAD ANATOMY of the three later stages, not just eyebrows. Thicketboar: moderately smaller eyes relative to skull, a longer squared muzzle, stronger bridge of nose, emerging cheek planes, more swept-back leaf ears, lean adolescent proportions and a defiant focused expression. Thornback: a distinctly mature powerful boar skull, MUCH smaller narrow almond eyes, heavy brow ridge integrated into the skull, longer wedge-shaped face with prominent broad nose bridge, angular cream jaw and cheek planes, longer lower tusks and a closed stern mouth. No big round baby eyes, no inflated plush cheeks, no puppy smile. Keep snout/cream face/leaf ears/grove identity. Make the normal final look like an imposing woodland guardian. Completely REIMAGINE the MEGA bottom-right panel to be substantially more dramatic than the final, not simply more flowers: a low, broad, ancient ROOT-COLOSSUS boar with a sloping mature head and fierce narrow amber eyes, ivory bark mask along angular cheeks, massive upward/forward branching lower tusks like interlocking plough blades, root-woven forequarters twice as broad as the hindquarters, chunky cloven forefeet and dark bark plates growing organically from the shoulders. Its back becomes a bold OPEN FAN of twisting living boughs with several broad emerald leaf masses and large cream-gold blossoms, a crown-like silhouette completely distinct from the normal final's flat tree canopy. Root strands brace its chest and forelegs, but clearly show all FOUR legs and the boar body; not a tree with an animal head glued on. Increase contrast with deep forest green and ivory-bark accents while preserving the species. The Mega must feel like an extraordinary temporary apex transformation, strong and fierce rather than evil or grotesque. No deer antlers, wings, humanoid armor, human hands, extra limbs or cluttered floating effects. Whole silhouettes must fit inside each panel without cropping, retain all labels, don't add new text or stats.
prompts.ripplet: Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise this Ripplet family board as a new concept version. Keep the 2x2 composition, exact names and labels and upper-left BASE RIPPLET's approved playful baby identity intact. The later faces currently look like the same cute baby enlarged. Give them real cranial maturation, as decisive as Charmander-to-Charmeleon-to-Charizard's progression, without borrowing their designs. Riverwisp needs smaller eyes, a longer tapered muzzle, firmer chin, less rounded cheek and a teenage confident half-smirk; restrain its developing frill so it isn't already the adult's crown. Tidewyrm needs a visibly ADULT RIVER DRAGON skull: long tapered wedge-shaped snout, sharp cream jawline, bony blue brow crests, narrow golden eyes about half the relative size of the baby's, small visible corner fang, a composed fierce closed-mouth expression. No huge circular eyes, round baby cheek, smiling puppy/lizard head or plush face on the final. Retain the gold eyes, yellow cheek landmark, cream underside and blue head crest as evolving identity anchors. Body remains an elegant long FOUR-LEGGED river dragon with a mature wave-frill crown. Completely redesign the MEGA panel into a dramatic STORM-TIDE DRAGON: darker midnight-blue back and teal body with striking ivory/ice-blue fin edges, a longer fierce armored-looking REPTILIAN face, swept backward paired blade fins growing from its head, a huge rigid layered wave-crown frill rising like a breaker behind the shoulders, prominent connected dorsal sail sweeping toward a muscular long tail with a three-pronged hydrofoil/trident FIN tip, broad powerful fin-edged forelegs and sharp ivory claws. Low commanding stance, long athletic body, all FOUR legs explicit. Tail, crown and head silhouette must be obviously different from normal Tidewyrm even in black silhouette. These are biological fins and scutes, not metal armor; keep the crown attached to the anatomy and don't obscure the face with floating water. Dramatic and majestic, not fluffy/cuddly or just larger fins. No wings, extra limbs/heads, human arms, random horns, weapons, jewelry, detachable water rings or generic sea serpent. Every complete character stays inside its own panel with visible margins; retain text and layout; no new names, stats or type labels.
prompts.cindercub: Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise this Cindercub family board as a new concept version. Keep all exact stage labels, 2x2 layout and approved upper-left BASE CINDERCUB playful puppy identity. The user wants faces to truly grow up like Charmander-to-Charmeleon-to-Charizard in degree of maturation, NOT a copy of those creatures. CHANGE the cranial proportions across the later stages. Smoulderpup gets a longer muzzle, firmer lower jaw, smaller almond-shaped eyes, lean adolescent cheek and restless serious expression, retaining oversized ears and lanky paws. Blazefang must look fully ADULT and fierce: a significantly longer strong wolf muzzle, broad angular jaw, sharp cheek planes, integrated sloped brow, smaller narrow amber eyes with focused pupils, longer fangs and a closed stern battle-ready mouth. Replace the huge cute baby eyes and round smiling cheek. Keep its orange forehead blaze, cream muzzle/chest, charcoal/ember coat and recognizable wolf ears, but the adult is a proud formidable apex wolf. Reimagine the MEGA panel much more dramatically than the current final: a dark OBSIDIAN-AND-SUNFIRE HEARTH WOLF, low long forward-driving stance, very broad angular forequarters, raised jagged charcoal shoulder ruff framing a fierce adult long-muzzled head, two enormous swept-back crescent-shaped FLAME MANTLES attached to the shoulders like a blazing crown, a white-gold fire core flowing continuously from the cream V chest into those orange/red mantles, heavy obsidian-black forepaws with visible ivory claws and bright ember seams, slimmer hindquarters, long dark tail splitting into THREE clean flame-plume lobes. The shoulder crown changes its outline dramatically and rises above the back without becoming literal wings. Retain a SINGLE wolf head, FOUR legs, visible pointed ears and a loyal intelligent face: powerful and fierce, not an evil demon. Use a stronger black/ivory-gold/orange palette split than ordinary Blazefang, distinct head/forequarter/tail silhouette instead of simply more little fire wisps. No human armor/clothing, biped, horn helmet, wings, extra limbs, random crystals or floating glyphs. Keep complete creatures and flame tips within their panels and clear of labels; preserve the overall original illustration finish.
